Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You brace your companion, turn their face and clear the obstruction before panic takes their breath.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing creature, immediately after temporary Asleep or Poisoned is applied by an inhaled substance.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires one free hand; grants no item.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Recovery

Reduce the newly applied temporary condition by 2, minimum 0. Choose one if both were applied. This does not undo damage, restore HP, remove an existing contribution or treat a starred condition. An unconscious ally can receive this aid.
